title: Mordheim KB catalogue — catalog/rules/implemented-canonical-families.yaml
description: Tracker of the shared executable families and the band rules that belong to each one. It records which rule ids share a compiler, trait or mechanic binding; update it when bindings evolve.

schema_version.description: This tracker kept version 1 when the other editorial documents moved to 2.

status.description: Editorial status of the tracker. Currently `executable`.

counts.description: Size of the tracker, by family and by binding kind. It must agree with `families`.

id.description: Stable id of the shared binding (`compiler.*`, `mechanic.*` or `trait.*`).

kind.description: Binding kind shared by every member of the family.

implemented.description: Whether the family has an executable implementation.

basis.description: Why the rules are considered equivalent: identical effect, equivalent effects, or a shared effect.

members.description: Band rules of the family, as `<band-id>/<rule-id>`.
